space.titleA: I build software from the ground up
space.lead: I'm Jesus Liang, Lead Fullstack Engineer at Availroom. I design, build and ship SaaS products with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Docker and Applied AI.
space.concept: This site is the journey in reverse: it goes down layer by layer, from what is already in orbit to the foundations that hold it up.

milestones.text: Migrated a monolithic jQuery social network to a React SPA, step by step and without breaking the PHP backend.
The real-time PMS, the smart-lock check-in app and the white-label booking engine.
Lead end-to-end technical delivery of new products alongside the CTO, founders and design: AI RMS, omnichannel platform, Booking v3, CRM and Docker/Coolify deployments.

city.aboutTitle: Six years turning ideas into products.
city.aboutText: Since 2020 I've been building software real people use every day: AI Revenue Management systems, real-time interfaces, hardware integrations, widgets running inside third-party websites and AI agents in production. What I enjoy most is the full cycle: deciding how something gets built alongside product and design, building it, shipping it and seeing how it behaves in the real world.

rms.title: AI Revenue Management System (RMS)
rms.summary: A multi-tenant RMS integrated into the PMS that forecasts demand, monitors Booking.com & Airbnb competitor rates and delivers explainable pricing recommendations.
rms.challenge: Manually pricing hundreds of properties across 365 days leaves revenue on the table in peak season and loses occupancy in low season. We needed an in-house engine wired into the PMS that clearly justifies every price recommendation.
built: Architected a multi-tenant system from scratch with Node.js/TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis and BullMQ async queues.
Integrated demand forecasting, Booking.com & Airbnb competitor rate monitoring (DataForSEO, Bright Data) and backtesting validation.
Built the strategy and explainable recommendations UI inside Availroom OS, currently piloted with 100+ properties.

ai.title: Omnichannel platform with AI agents
ai.summary: Every guest message in one real-time inbox, with a WhatsApp Business microservice and PMS-connected AI agents that translate and act.
ai.challenge: Property managers talk to guests from all over the world through WhatsApp, email and the OTAs, and most replies require checking or changing something in the PMS: rates, cleanings, arrival times.
built: Architected a WhatsApp Business microservice (Meta Cloud API, templates and coexistence) on RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and S3.
Integrated PMS-connected AI agents automating operational workflows such as rates, cleanings, translations and contextual replies.
Connected all messaging into a real-time unified inbox powered by WebSockets.

pms.title: Availroom OS · PMS / Channel Manager
pms.summary: The platform 150+ property managers run on every day: a desktop inside the browser with real-time multi-user collaboration.
pms.challenge: Managers juggle dozens of properties and several channels, and their teams edit the same bookings at the same time. They needed a tool as fast as a desktop app where nobody overwrites anybody else's work.
built: New management dashboard (React 19, Vite, Tailwind/shadcn, Zustand) featuring WebSocket messaging, rates, minimum stays and the RMS module.
A Node.js and Express WebSocket microservice for Figma- or Google Docs-style real-time collaboration.
Gradual migration of the core to microservices and automated deployments with Docker and Coolify.

booking.title: White-label booking engine
booking.summary: A Next.js widget any hotel or property manager embeds without iframes (Shadow DOM) or via an SEO-friendly SSR WordPress plugin to sell direct.
booking.challenge: Every client runs a different website: WordPress, templates or custom builds. It had to deliver a complete booking flow with price map and checkout without iframes while ranking well on search engines.
built: Evolved the engine to Next.js and TypeScript, embeddable without iframes via a Shadow DOM script for style isolation.
Built a WordPress plugin with server-side rendering (SSR) for full SEO across property pages and checkout.
Google Maps price pins, filters, real-time availability and payment checkout wired to the PMS.

checkin.title: Digital check-in with AI scanning & smart locks
checkin.summary: Guests check in from their phone, scan their ID document and open the door without keys across 6,000+ properties.
checkin.challenge: Handing over keys and collecting documents in person doesn't scale across thousands of properties. The entire flow had to work from the guest's phone with reliable document extraction.
built: Online check-in flow for 6,000+ properties featuring digital signatures and smart-lock integrations.
Engineered a provider-agnostic document scanning microservice (Claude / OpenAI API structured outputs) with deterministic MRZ and Spanish ID validation.
Designed to replace the legacy SDK across 2,500–4,000 monthly document scans.

crm.title: Predictive real estate CRM
crm.summary: A CRM built from scratch that extracts market data (AirDNA, Puppeteer) to forecast profitability and generate PDF proposals for the acquisition team.
crm.challenge: The acquisition team needed to decide quickly which properties to onboard and under what terms, without living in manual spreadsheets.
built: Led CRM development from scratch with Next.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Redis and Socket.io.
Integrated market data (AirDNA, Puppeteer) to model fixed, variable and hybrid profitability.
Automated PDF proposals and contract generation for the sales team.

leaderslinked.title: Leaders Linked
leaderslinked.summary: Migrating a monolithic jQuery and PHP professional social network to a React SPA without stopping the service.
leaderslinked.challenge: The social network was a PHP monolith with jQuery. The frontend had to be modernised without a big-bang rewrite that would halt the product.
built: Refactored the interface into a React SPA.
Configured Webpack for a gradual transition on top of the PHP backend.
Finally decoupled the frontend from the backend.
